title: “El baile de los pajaritos” by Parchís
text: The "Chicken Dance", also known as "The Birdie Song") is an oom-pah song from 1957. The original German language version was composed by Swiss accordionist Werner Thomas.
listen: El baile de los pajaritos Parchís

title: “Marcha de las Malvinas” by Banda Original Columbia
text: The Marcha de las Malvinas is a patriotic anthem of Argentina. It is sung in demonstrations to assert Argentina sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands (in Spanish: Islas Malvinas) and was prominently broadcast by the military government (controlled media during the Falklands War).
listen: Marcha de las Malvinas Banda Original Columbia

title: “Puerto Pollensa” by Sandra Mihanovich
text: Sandra Mihanovich is an Argentine singer, musician, and composer of rock, blues, and tango rhythms.

title: “Dueño de nada” by José Luis Rodríguez
text: José Luis Rodríguez González, nicknamed El Puma ("The Puma"), is a Venezuelan singer and actor who is known for having recorded many international super hits and participated in a handful of telenovelas. He has also served as a coach and mentor on the Argentine, the Peruvian, and the Chilean versions of The Voice, as well as a judge on The X Factor Chile.
listen: Dueño de nada José Luis Rodríguez

title: “Yo tengo un amigo” by Lucecita Benítez
text: Luz Esther Benítez Rosado, also known as Lucecita, is a Puerto Rican singer, part of the country's new wave popular music. Born in Bayamon, a large city in Puerto Rico, she participated in amateur radio shows.
listen: Yo tengo un amigo Lucecita Benítez

title: Allan Hills A81005, the first lunar meteorite found on Earth, is discovered in the Allan Hills at the end of the Transantarctic Mountains by John Schutt and Ian Whillans during the ANSMET meteorite gathering expedition.
text: Allan Hills A81005 or ALH A81005 was the first meteorite to be recognised as a lunar meteorite. The meteorite Yamato 791197 was discovered in 1979 but its lunar origin was not recognised until 1984.

title: Syzygy: all 9 planets align on the same side of the Sun.
text: In astronomy, a syzygy is a roughly straight-line configuration of three or more celestial bodies in a gravitational system. The word is often used in reference to the Sun, Earth, and either the Moon or a planet, where the latter is in conjunction or opposition.

title: Halley's Comet: First spotted in the sky after 70 year return.
text: Halley's Comet is the only known short-period comet that is consistently visible to the naked eye from Earth, appearing roughly every 74–79 years. It last appeared in the inner parts of the Solar System in 1986 and will next appear in mid-2061.
